CHEVRON.silhouette_basis: Inscribed label rectangle clears the full-height tail notch and arrow tip of the visible chevron silhouette.

HEXAGON.silhouette_basis: Inscribed label rectangle clears the sloped left and right shoulders of the visible six-sided silhouette.

TRAPEZOID.silhouette_basis: Inscribed label rectangle uses the narrower parallel edge and clears both visible sloped sides.

PARALLELOGRAM.silhouette_basis: Inscribed label rectangle clears both visible slanted sides across the shape height.

DIAMOND.silhouette_basis: Central half-width by half-height rectangle is inscribed inside the four visible diagonal edges.

ELLIPSE.silhouette_basis: Near-maximum axis-aligned rectangle is inscribed inside the visible ellipse rather than its bounding frame.

ROUND_RECTANGLE.silhouette_basis: Label rectangle clears the visible rounded corners and remains in the stable central surface.
